240-4068-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-4068-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

5078-6650-7295-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-6650-7295-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3490-5477-7075-7292.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-5477-7075-7292.description:
Activate an artifact creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-849-3249-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-849-3249-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4050-4533-4807-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control less than three Blood tokens.
4050-4533-4807-7824.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Falkenrath Forebear, adding {B}.
When Falkenrath Forebear dies, Voldaren Bloodcaster triggers, creating two Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Falkenrath Forebear by paying {B} and sacrificing the Blood tokens, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

4785-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4785-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4785-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

640-2173-4496-5220.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1292-3117-5078-7650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2724-3217-7638.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using The Mind Stone. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1036-2060-3525-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Wellwisher does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Wellwisher.
1036-2060-3525-6996.description:
Activate Wellwisher by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Wellwisher.
Repeat.

2919-3490-4659-7399.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4659-7399.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3809-4917-5184-5200.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two other artifact creatures.
3809-4917-5184-5200.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.
3809-4917-5184-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana and Treasure tokens, you can use Jan Jansen's second ability, paired with untapping it, infinitely to get infinite Construct tokens.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7379.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Zack Fair.
When Zack Fair dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

206-3101-3292-3892.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
206-3101-3292-3892.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
206-3101-3292-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

632-2034-3621-5129-7175.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3621-5129-7175.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

2060-2700-2744-3334-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Arcbound Shikari trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2781-4590-6884.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that can attack this turn.
2781-4590-6884.description:
Declare two creatures as attackers, ensuring to attack two different opponents. Commander Liara Portyr triggers, causing spells you cast from exile this turn to cost {2} less to cast.
Cast Aang by paying its mana cost.
When Aang enters, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it from exile later.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0} due to Commander Liara Portyr.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Aang
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2228-3108-3504.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Mercurial Pretender.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Mercurial Pretender by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1494-5014-6822-6838.description:
If you have more than three cards in hand, activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have three or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Doctor Octopus triggers, causing you to draw at least five cards.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

792-4050-6115.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {1}.
When Ozox dies, it and Totentanz trigger.
Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Jumblebones and the other creature token, adding {1}{B}.
When Jumblebones dies, it triggers, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

1479-5478-5700-5701-6662.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5478-5700-5701-6662.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1329-1778-2178-2292.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-2292.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1228-5470-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
1228-5470-5686.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat from step 2.

2097-4067-5742-5743.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

891-2386-3967-5220.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2386-3967-5220.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Mortuary and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant from your library onto the battlefield.
When Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1322-1858-2056.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1322-1858-2056.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

947-1132-1305-5184.description:
Cast Heaven Sent by paying {U}{R}.
Widespread Thieving triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve Heaven Sent, choosing to have it enter the battlefield with three chapter counters on it due to its read ahead ability.
Heaven Sent's third chapter ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent, and causing you to draw seven cards if an opponent has 0 or less life, or otherwise exile Heaven Sent with the ability to play it this turn.
If Heaven Sent was exiled this way, repeat until Heaven Sent is not exiled.

1636-2108-4731-5220.notablePrerequisites: Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2108-4731-5220.description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Onulet.
When Onulet dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Onulet trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Onulet on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Onulet from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Onulet enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

4050-4080-4577-4772.notablePrerequisites: Magnanimous Magistrate has at least three reprieve counters.
4050-4080-4577-4772.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Huatli's Raptor, adding one mana of any color.
Huatli's Raptor dies, triggering Magnanimous Magistrate, causing you to remove two reprieve counters from Magnanimous Magistrate and return Huatli's Raptor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Huatli's Raptor enters the battlefield, causing you to proliferate, putting two reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Repeat.

2741-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
2741-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Essence Warden and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Essence Warden and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

174-877-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, causing target player to mill cards equal to Worldheart Phoenix's power.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.

364-1987-2493-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
